    How Online Consultations Work

    Follow these simple steps to consult with a licensed doctor on PulseLink

    1

    Create an Account or Log In

    Sign up or log in to start booking consultations with licensed doctors.

    2

    Browse Doctors

    Search and filter doctors by specialty and availability.

    3

    Book an Appointment

    Choose a date and time based on the doctor’s available schedule for online or in-clinic consultation.

    4

    Consult with the Doctor

    Join a secure video call or visit the clinic on your scheduled time.
